pages.title: Suicide prevention: how to get help now
pages.text: If you are having thoughts of suicide, help is available. Trained counsellors are on the line day and night. Self-harm is not something you have to face alone.

pages.title: Finding a domestic violence shelter near you
pages.text: Leaving an abusive partner is dangerous. Domestic violence advocates can help you build a safety plan and find emergency housing tonight.

pages.title: Recognising the early signs of an eating disorder
pages.text: Anorexia and bulimia often begin quietly. A person may restrict food, exercise compulsively, or withdraw from meals with others.

pages.title: After a sexual assault: your options
pages.text: Survivors of rape and sexual assault can seek medical care, report to police, or do neither. Advocates are available to explain each option without pressure.

pages.title: Breaking: mass shooting reported downtown
pages.text: Police responded to reports of a mass shooting this afternoon. Officials have not confirmed casualties. The area remains closed.

pages.title: Living with grief after a sudden death
pages.text: Grief after a sudden bereavement does not follow stages. Many people describe trauma symptoms months later, long after others expect them to have moved on.

pages.title: I don't want to be here anymore
pages.text: Some nights I think about ending it all. I don't have a plan exactly, I just want the noise to stop and for everything to be over.

pages.title: Detoxing from alcohol at home is dangerous
pages.text: Withdrawal from heavy drinking can cause seizures. People in recovery from addiction should not attempt an unsupervised detox.

pages.title: What to expect after a miscarriage
pages.text: Pregnancy loss in the first trimester is common and rarely anyone's fault. Physical recovery takes days; the rest takes longer.

pages.title: Talking to your family about a terminal diagnosis
pages.text: A palliative care team can help you decide what to say and when. Hospice does not mean giving up on comfort.

pages.title: Prevención del suicidio: líneas de ayuda
pages.text: Si tienes pensamientos de quitarte la vida, hay ayuda disponible. Los consejeros atienden a cualquier hora del día.

pages.title: The Great Depression: causes and consequences
pages.text: The Great Depression began with the 1929 crash. Unemployment reached twenty-five percent and the resulting economic depression reshaped a generation of policy.

pages.title: Grief counselling degree programs, ranked
pages.text: A master's in grief counselling prepares graduates for hospice and bereavement work. Programs vary in clinical hours, tuition, and licensure pathway.

pages.title: How the Armenian genocide is taught in schools
pages.text: Historians debate how the genocide should appear in secondary curricula. The question is one of pedagogy and national memory more than of fact.

pages.title: Chapter 12: Eating disorders — a clinical overview
pages.text: This chapter surveys the diagnostic criteria for anorexia nervosa and bulimia nervosa, prevalence by cohort, and the evidence base for family-based treatment.

pages.title: Blunt force trauma testing in helmet design
pages.text: Impact trauma is measured with an instrumented headform. Engineers compare abuse-case loads against the standard's threshold.

pages.title: Is the housing market in a depression or a correction?
pages.text: Analysts disagree on whether the current slump counts as a depression. Volume is down, prices are flat, and inventory is rising.

pages.title: The best weeknight tomato pasta
pages.text: Blister the tomatoes in olive oil until they collapse. Add garlic, a splash of pasta water, and finish off the heat with basil.

pages.title: Understanding lifetimes in Rust
pages.text: A lifetime annotation tells the borrow checker how long a reference is valid. Most of the time elision handles it for you.

pages.title: Transfer window: the ten deals still on the table
pages.text: Clubs have until Monday to complete business. Two of the moves below hinge on a medical, and one on a manager who has not yet been appointed.

pages.title: Officials investigate possible terrorism motive in overnight attack
pages.text: Investigators say terrorism has not been ruled out following an attack on a transit hub overnight. No group has claimed responsibility. Commuters should expect delays through the morning.

pages.title: Five years of recovery from self-harm
pages.text: Self-harm was how I coped for most of my twenties. Recovery wasn't linear, and there were setbacks I'm not proud of, but I want to talk honestly about what actually helped.

pages.title: Survivors describe the genocide a decade on
pages.text: A decade later, survivors are still describing the genocide in testimony collected for the tribunal. Many carry visible trauma from what they witnessed, and few have received any formal acknowledgement.

pages.title: Inside a city's mental health crisis response team
pages.text: The team responds to roughly forty calls a night, most involving someone in the middle of a mental health crisis with nowhere else to turn. Untreated depression is the single most common thread among the people they meet.

pages.title: I've started again and I don't know how to stop
pages.text: I told myself I wouldn't do it again but I've been hurting myself on purpose for the last few weeks. Nobody at home knows. I don't really know why I'm writing this down.

pages.title: Some days I just want it to be over
pages.text: Lately I keep thinking about not being around anymore, like everyone would just adjust and move on. I haven't told anyone because I don't want the whole conversation that would follow.

pages.title: Things at home have gotten scary
pages.text: He didn't used to put his hands on me. Now I flinch before he even raises his voice, and I've started keeping a bag packed in the car in case tonight is the night I finally leave.

pages.title: Fentanyl is now in almost everything on the street
pages.text: Overdose deaths in the county rose again last year, and testing strips show fentanyl turning up in supplies where users don't expect it. Naloxone kits are free at the health department, no questions asked.

pages.title: What to do if a manager is bullying you
pages.text: Persistent belittling from a manager in front of colleagues is not something you have to accept quietly. Document dates, times and witnesses before you escalate to HR, and know that retaliation for reporting is itself against most companies' policy.

pages.title: A night at the city's largest shelter
pages.text: Every bed was full by nine, and a dozen more people slept in the overflow hallway on donated mats. Most of the people here had a place to live eighteen months ago; a missed paycheck or a medical bill was often all it took.

pages.title: Finding an apartment after prison
pages.text: Most landlords won't consider an application once a background check comes back with a record, no matter how long ago the sentence was served. A handful of reentry programs now co-sign leases to get around exactly this problem.

pages.title: The first Christmas without my mother
pages.text: Every tradition we used to have felt wrong to do alone this year, so I skipped most of them. I keep reaching for the phone to call her before I remember.

pages.title: What clinical depression actually feels like day to day
pages.text: It isn't sadness so much as a grey flatness that sits over everything, including the things that used to matter to me. Getting out of bed some mornings takes an hour of just deciding to.

pages.title: Why the flashbacks come back at random
pages.text: A smell or a sound from that night can put me right back there with no warning at all, years later. My therapist says this is completely ordinary and that it does eventually space out.

pages.title: Realising, years later, what happened wasn't normal
pages.text: It took me most of my twenties to call what my stepfather did what it actually was. Naming it changed nothing about what happened, but it changed a lot about what I could do next.

pages.title: Vivre avec des troubles alimentaires
pages.text: Beaucoup de personnes souffrant de troubles alimentaires cachent leurs symptomes pendant des annees avant d'en parler. Demander de l'aide n'est pas un signe de faiblesse.

pages.title: Wenn zu Hause Gewalt herrscht
pages.text: Viele Betroffene hauslicher Gewalt zoegern jahrelang, bevor sie sich Hilfe suchen. Beratungsstellen bieten anonyme und kostenlose Erstgespraeche an, auch am Wochenende.

pages.title: Aatmahatya ke vichar aane par kya karein
pages.text: Agar aapke man mein khud ko nuksan pahunchane ke vichar aa rahe hain, to akele is se mat guzriye. Helpline par bina naam bataye baat ki ja sakti hai, chauबीस ghante.

pages.title: Teaching the twentieth century's darkest chapters
pages.text: A unit on genocide is now standard in most secondary history curricula, though teachers differ widely on how much detail is age-appropriate. The department reviews the syllabus every three years.

pages.title: What trauma-informed teaching actually means in practice
pages.text: Trauma-informed does not mean lowering academic expectations; it means predictable routines and choice in how a student demonstrates understanding. The framework has spread quickly through teacher training programs.

pages.title: How grief is represented across three centuries of the novel
pages.text: The seminar traces how the depiction of grief shifts from stylised Victorian mourning to the fragmented, non-linear treatments common in contemporary fiction. Attendance for the final session is mandatory.

pages.title: How a depression forms over warm ocean water
pages.text: A tropical depression forms when a cluster of thunderstorms organises around a shared centre of low pressure. Most dissipate within days; a small fraction strengthen into named storms.

pages.title: Rate-limiting to prevent API abuse
pages.text: A sliding-window limiter is usually enough to stop casual abuse of a public endpoint without penalising legitimate high-volume users. Sudden traffic spikes should still page someone.

pages.title: Comparing bereavement leave policies across the industry
pages.text: Most companies in the survey offer between three and five days of bereavement leave, with a minority extending this to extended family. HR should review the policy alongside parental leave this quarter.

pages.title: Getting a reliable sourdough starter going
pages.text: Feed it equal parts flour and water by weight, at room temperature, and expect it to take five to seven days before it's reliably doubling. A hooch layer on top just means it's hungry, not dead.

pages.title: Three ridge hikes under four hours from the city
pages.text: All three trailheads have parking that fills by nine on weekends, so an early start matters more than fitness level here. Bring more water than you think you need on the exposed sections.

pages.title: CSS grid versus flexbox, for real this time
pages.text: Grid is for two-dimensional layout, rows and columns together; flexbox is for one dimension at a time. Most real layouts end up using both, nested inside each other.
